scenes.basis: 15:1 "Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers" - the dispute is at Antioch, where Paul and Barnabas were staying (14:26-28) and where the letter is later delivered (15:30)
15:3 "passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles" - a journey through two regions with no single setting
15:4 "When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders"; 15:6 "The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter"

15:22 "it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas"; 15:23 "They wrote these things by their hand" - the letter's addressees in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia are addressees, never settings

15:30 "when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter"; 15:35 "But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord"
15:39 "the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other" - the dispute and the parting name no place; they follow the Antioch stay of 15:35; Cyprus (15:39) is Barnabas's departure leg
15:41 "He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies" - a journey through two regions with no single setting; the following scene is at Derbe and Lystra (16:1)
